__meta__.description: qualcomm IQ-9075 (Hexagon v73 HTP) FP16 column for the three-platform vision corpus. Companion to backend's vision_corpus_three_platform.json — DO NOT merge blindly; iq9 metric is AI Hub on-device estimated_inference_time (single value), mapped to the compute_p50_ms slot.
__meta__.metric: estimated_inference_time (on-device, AI Hub) in ms; ~ compute time, no explicit p50/p99
__meta__.author: Kyle Fox / Claude Code Opus v4.8
__meta__.corpus_rev: rev2 (+ 2 local packaging patches, see corpus_packaging_issues)
__meta__.headline: Every model 100% on HTP — no CPU spill, no op-cliff, incl efficientsam_decoder which Orin's TRT 10.3 fails to build. iq9/Orin ratio 2.3-3.4x on CNN/low-res-ViT, widening to 16-18x on high-resolution attention (efficientsam-enc 1024^2, yoloe open-vocab) — compute scaling, not a datapath cliff.
corpus_packaging_issues: resnet50v1.onnx: qai_hub upload did not include the external-weights .data sidecar -> 'missing external weights'. Fixed locally by inlining weights (onnx.save save_as_external_data=False).
yolov8n-seg / yolo11s-seg / yoloe-26s-seg-pf: output0/output1 present in BOTH value_info and graph IO -> AI Hub ONNX validation reject. Fixed locally by stripping the duplicate value_info entries.
__meta__.int8_note: FP16 only this pass (the honest cross-platform axis per backend). Calibrated QNN-INT8 iq9-only column is a follow-up.
